### Props

| Name                   | Type      | Required | Default                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------- | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `manifest`             | `union`   |          | `null`                                                     | Reactive app manifest (from `useAppManifest`). `manifest.menu` is flattened (including one level of `children`) into the "navigation" source — every entry with a `route` or `href` becomes a "jump to page" result with zero app-side wiring. Entries with `type: 'caption'` (non-interactive section dividers) are skipped. Omit to run with navigation results disabled.     |
| `router`               | `union`   |          | `null`                                                     | vue-router instance, used to resolve navigation results (`router.push({ name: item.route, query: item.query })`, matching `CnAppNav`'s own resolution). Omit if the app has no router (the navigation source is then skipped even when `manifest` is set).                                                                                                                      |
| `objectSearch`         | `union`   |          | `null`                                                     | "Objects" source: `async (query) =&gt; resultItems[]`. Called (debounced by `objectSearchDebounce`) whenever the query changes. Each returned item MUST carry `{id, title, run}` and MAY carry `{subtitle, section, keywords, icon}` — the exact shape `createObjectSearchSource` (`src/utils/commandPaletteObjectSource.js`) produces. Omit to run without live object search. |
| `objectSearchDebounce` | `number`  |          | `200`                                                      | Debounce window (ms) before `objectSearch` is invoked after the query stops changing — keeps fast typing from firing a request per keystroke. Navigation/action results are unaffected (they're computed synchronously, client-side) so the palette never appears to "wait" on this.                                                                                            |
| `shortcut`             | `string`  |          | `'k'`                                                      | The key combined with Ctrl (Windows/Linux) or Cmd (macOS) that opens the palette. Case-insensitive.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `disableShortcut`      | `boolean` |          | `false`                                                    | Disable the built-in global Ctrl/Cmd+`shortcut` listener. Set this when the host app wants to drive `open()`/`close()`/`toggle()` itself (e.g. from its own toolbar button or a different shortcut) via `useCommandPalette()`.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `appId`                | `union`   |          | `null`                                                     | App id used to namespace the optional local recency/frequency boost (`localStorage`-only — see `commandPalette/recency.js`). Pass the app's own id so multiple apps on the same origin don't share one history bucket. Omit to disable the boost entirely (results still rank correctly by match tier, just without a "used recently" nudge).                                   |
| `navigationSection`    | `string`  |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Navigate')`                  | Section label for navigation results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `placeholder`          | `string`  |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Type a command or search…')` | Input placeholder / accessible name for the palette dialog.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `label`                | `string`  |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Command palette')`           | Accessible name for the dialog + combobox + listbox. Also the `NcDialog` header text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `commandRegistry`      | `union`   |          | `null`                                                     | Override registry (test isolation / a deliberately separate palette instance). Defaults to the shared singleton every `useCommandPalette()` call reads.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
